title: A Guide to Modern Python String Formatting Tools
description: Explore Python's modern string formatting tools, and learn to harness f-strings and the .format() method for interpolation and formatting.
summary: In modern Python, you have f-strings and the .format() method to approach the tasks of interpolating and formatting strings. These tools help you embed variables and expressions directly into strings, control text alignment, and use custom format specifiers to modify how values appear.
